stdio_review.algorithm_assessment: A shortest surface path on a convex box need not revisit a face: the portion between its first and last visits can be replaced by the straight segment within that convex face. Enumerate all simple adjacent-face paths between every face containing A and every face containing B. Unfold each next rectangle across its shared edge into the plane, placing its interior opposite the previous face. The candidate is the straight segment between the unfolded endpoints. Validate with exact rational intersection parameters that it crosses every shared edge in nondecreasing order and within that edge; collinear edge travel and corner crossings are allowed. Convexity of each rectangle then ensures the intervening segment remains inside it. Every valid unfolding gives an integer squared distance, so the minimum is exact without floating rounding. Common-face endpoints use the Euclidean lower bound directly.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
